status: registered before the full E8 run; only a 4-tile loading probe (e8_probe_rgb) was run and is not scored
paper_plan: docs/PAPER_EO_VLM_SKELETON_20260926.md (E8: apply the protocol to a public EO-VLM)
question: Zero-shot, does the public EO-VLM EarthDial (CVPR 2025) answer the landslide Q1 question from the images, from the prompt text, or not at all, under the same within-tile swap protocol used for our reader (MS-156)?

model.checkpoint: akshaydudhane/EarthDial_4B_RGB (HF sha recorded in manifest), modeling code from github.com/hiyamdebary/EarthDial src/ at commit 92c1260
model.runtime: .venv-master torch + isolated package dir third_party/earthdial_py (transformers 4.37.2, tokenizers 0.15.2, timm 0.9.12, sentencepiece 0.1.99, peft 0.7.1) placed first on PYTHONPATH for this run only (the repo pins transformers 4.37.2; transformers 5.15 fails at tokenizer load)
model.input_contract: docs/E8_EARTHDIAL_INPUT_CONTRACT_20260926.md; 512x512 RGB PNG renders of Sentinel-2 from sentinel_qa_v0_1, 448 bicubic, 1 tile + no thumbnail -> 256 tokens per image, one num_patches entry per <image>

prompt.primary: EarthDial's own two-image change template tag [changedet] [hr_rgb_temp_0.5] <image> <image> \n Did a landslide occur between the first image (taken on {d1}) and the second image (taken on {d2})? Please answer yes or no.
prompt.one_image_arms: [s2_rgb_10] <image> \n Is there a landslide visible in this image? Please answer yes or no.
prompt.note: [hr_rgb_temp_0.5] is the only two-image tag the model was trained with (0.5 m aerial); no S2 two-image tag exists. Dates are added so the swap arm can separate text from images

data: sentinel_qa_v0_1 Q1, tiles with both a yes item and a no item (192 tiles, 384 items; same test set as MS-156, exposed)
arms: swap_within_tile (prompt/dates of the item, images of the other item on the same tile)

primary_verdict.uninformative_low_signal: d_real < 0.10 (zero-shot the model does not separate the pairs; off-distribution task, not evidence that it ignores images)

descriptive_only: d_post, d_pre, d_real - d_post (paired tile bootstrap): does the two-image answer beat a post-image-only reading
balanced accuracy vs prompt gold and vs image gold
what_this_does_not_show: multispectral or SAR use (RGB checkpoint and RGB renders only; _MS/SAR is a later step)
EarthDial's quality on its own training distribution
compute: GPU1 (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1) only if no other process
